components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Primary conversion button with high-contrast emerald background and hover luminescence.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 10px; background: #00b231; color: #070d14; padding: 16px 32px; border-radius: 12px; font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 700; border: none; cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); box-shadow: 0 0 22px -2px rgba(0, 178, 49, 0.32); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #008f27; color: #f7fafc; transform: scale(1.02); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Hairline steel bordered action for secondary workflows and staging portal entry.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; background: #0e1724; color: #f7fafc; padding: 16px 32px; border-radius: 12px; font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 600; border: 1px solid #1b2a3d; cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { border-color: #2fa4e3; background: rgba(14, 23, 36, 0.8); }

components.name: Telemetry Pill
components.description: Monospace live status pill with pulsing signal for performance metrics and guarantees.
components.css: .ds-pill { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; background: rgba(0, 178, 49, 0.1); border: 1px solid rgba(0, 178, 49, 0.35); color: #00b231; padding: 6px 14px; border-radius: 9999px; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.04em; } .ds-pill-dot { width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 50%; background: #00b231; }

components.name: Interactive Metric Card
components.description: Engineered container for displaying benchmark telemetry and key deliverables.
components.css: .ds-card { background: rgba(14, 23, 36, 0.9); border: 1px solid #1b2a3d; border-radius: 16px; padding: 24px; transition: all 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); backdrop-filter: blur(12px); } .ds-card:hover { transform: translateY(-4px); box-shadow: 0 0 35px -5px rgba(0, 178, 49, 0.16); border-color: rgba(0, 178, 49, 0.4); } .ds-card-metric { font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 28px; font-weight: 800; color: #00b231; } .ds-card-label { margin-top: 6px; font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; color: rgba(247, 250, 252, 0.85); }

components.name: Navigation Shell
components.description: Sticky top bar with obsidian backdrop blur and hairline divider.
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; padding: 14px 28px; background: rgba(7, 13, 20, 0.85); backdrop-filter: blur(16px); border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(27, 42, 61, 0.8); } .ds-nav-brand { font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif; font-weight: 800; font-size: 18px; color: #f7fafc; } .ds-nav-links { display: flex; gap: 20px; font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; color: #94a6b8; } .ds-nav-active { color: #00b231; font-weight: 600; }

narrative.overview:
The Edge Terminal visual identity reflects high-velocity engineering precision, enterprise robustness, and zero-friction operational authority. Rooted in developer tooling aesthetics, the canvas is an abyss of deep Obsidian (#070d14) punctuated by tactical Slate surfaces (#0e1724), razor-sharp hairline Steel borders (#1b2a3d), and active pulse signals in Telemetry Emerald (#00b231) and Electric Indigo (#2fa4e3).

The system avoids the pastel softness of generic B2B SaaS in favor of technical high-density clarity: dark-mode only, legible typography pairings with dedicated monospace telemetry data, and subtle 44px cybernetic background grids. The experience communicates instant speed, transparent deployment, and complete mechanical control.
keyCharacteristics: High-contrast obsidian dark palette with emerald and indigo status luminescence
Typographic hierarchy separating assertive marketing display from precise monospace telemetry
Tonal depth created with hairline steel borders and subtle backdrop-blur rather than heavy drop shadows
Interactive responsiveness featuring micro-elevations, pulsing status rings, and live messaging simulations

rules.name: The Telemetry Rarity Rule
rules.body: Telemetry Emerald is strictly a signal color. It is applied to no more than 10% of any viewport to preserve its punch as a conversion trigger and live indicator.

rules.name: The Dual-Accent Division Rule
rules.body: Telemetry Emerald always signals action, speed, or performance; Electric Indigo always signals structural categorization, segments, or informational links. Never invert their roles.

rules.name: The Monospace Proof Rule
rules.body: All quantitative metrics (PageSpeed scores, latencies, percentages, pricing tiers, timestamps) must be rendered in JetBrains Mono. Numbers are technical proof, not marketing prose.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: All surfaces rest completely flat on the Obsidian canvas. Shadows and luminous glows exist only as reactive responses to user interaction, active polling, or live telemetry states.

dos: Do format all performance scores, latencies, metrics, and timestamps in JetBrains Mono.
Do use hairline steel borders (#1b2a3d) on all cards to maintain visual separation on dark backgrounds.
Do restrict Telemetry Emerald to active CTAs, success metrics, and real-time indicators.
Do use subtle background radial glows (rgba(0, 178, 49, 0.15)) behind hero and signature sections to create atmospheric depth.
donts: Don't introduce light-mode backgrounds, pure white cards, or pastel fills.
Don't use generic decorative serif fonts or playful handwritten styles.
Don't use heavy drop shadows without steel borders; depth on dark canvases must be structural.
Don't color body paragraphs in pure #ffffff; always use Snow (#f7fafc) or Cool Gray (#94a6b8) for contrast balance.
